name: Sustainability Assessment and Green Building Design
description: Introduction to sustainability concepts, sustainable materials and parameters, environmental footprint, GHG accounting, water footprint, ecological footprint, embodied carbon and energy, life cycle energy, life cycle assessment (LCA), life cycle costing (LCC), multi-criteria decision making (MCDM), energy conservation building code, green building rating systems – LEED, circular economy in construction, introduction to ESG. Practical activities – LCA software tools, energy modelling, footprint analysis and case studies.
